advanced-filter-card-dates-hint: Fili ʻa e ngaahi ʻaho ʻo e kaati ʻaki ʻa e @createdAt, @receivedAt, @startAt, @dueAt, @endAt pe @listEnteredAt. Fakatātā: @endAt >= '2026-01-01' pe @endAt = none. ʻĀ takai ʻaki ʻa e ngaahi fakaʻilonga lea ʻa e hingoa ʻo ha feituʻu fakapatonu ʻoku kamata ʻaki ʻa e @.
advanced-filter-description: ʻOku fakaʻatā ʻe he Sivi fakalakalaka ke tohi ha laine ʻoku ʻi ai ʻa e ngaahi fakahoko ko ʻení: == != <= >= && || ( ) ʻOku ngāueʻaki ha vahaʻa ko e fakamavaheʻi ʻi he vahaʻa ʻo e ngaahi fakahoko. ʻE lava ke ke sivi ʻa e ngaahi konga fakafoʻituitui kotoa ʻaki hono tohi honau ngaahi hingoa mo e mahuʻinga. Hangē ko ʻení: Field1 == Value1. Fakatokanga: Kapau ʻoku ʻi ai ha vahaʻa ʻi he ngaahi konga pe mahuʻinga, kuo pau ke ke kofukofuʻi kinautolu ʻaki ha fakaʻilonga lea taha. Hangē ko ʻení: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Ke hopo ʻa e ngaahi mataʻitohi pule taha (' \/), ʻe lava ke ke ngāueʻaki ʻa e \. Hangē ko ʻení: Field1 == I\'m. ʻE lava foki ke ke fakataha ʻa e ngaahi tuʻunga lahi. Hangē ko ʻení: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. ʻI he angamaheni ʻoku lau ʻa e ngaahi fakahoko kotoa mei toʻohema ki toʻomataʻu. ʻE lava ke ke liliu ʻa e hokohoko ʻaki hono ʻai ha ngaahi puha. Hangē ko ʻení: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). ʻE lava foki ke ke kumi ʻi he ngaahi konga tohi ʻaki ʻa e regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i
text-contains-trigger-description: Fehoanaki ‘i he taimi ‘oku ngaohi ai ha kaati, pe liliu hono kaveinga pe fakamatala, pea ‘oku ‘i ai ‘i he tohi fo‘ou ‘a e me‘a ni (‘oku ‘ikai mahu‘inga’ia ‘i he lahi pe si’i ‘o e mataliliu).
header-logo-title: Foki ki he peesi ʻo hoʻo ngaahi papa.
imported-member-no-account: Mēmipa naʻe hū mai — ʻoku teʻeki ha ʻakauni ʻoku hoa
impersonate-user: Ngāue ʻo hangē ko e tokotaha ngāueʻaki
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Pēsiti ha JSON hū atu mei he Kanboard: ko ha meʻa ʻoku ʻi ai ʻa e "columns" (pe ngaahi ngāue ʻoku ʻi ai ʻa e column_name) mo ha fakahokohoko "tasks" (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). ʻE hoko ʻa e ngaahi kolomu ko e ngaahi lisi pea ko e ngaahi ngāue ko e ngaahi kaati.
import-board-instruction-deck: Pēsiti ha JSON ʻo ha papa NextCloud Deck (ko ha papa ʻoku ʻi ai ʻa e "stacks", ʻoku ʻi he stack takitaha ʻa hono "cards"). ʻE hoko ʻa e ngaahi stack ko e ngaahi lisi pea ko e ngaahi kaati ko e ngaahi kaati.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Pēsiti ha JSON ʻo ha tānaki work-packages mei he OpenProject (GET /api/v3/work_packages). ʻE hoko ʻa e ngaahi tuʻunga ko e ngaahi lisi pea ko e ngaahi work package ko e ngaahi kaati.
import-board-instruction-issues: Pēsiti ha fakahokohoko JSON ʻo e ngaahi palopalema mei he __sourceName__ (__endpoint__). ʻE hoko ʻa e ngaahi palopalema ko e ngaahi kaati kuo fakakulupu ki he ngaahi lisi Ava / Tāpuni.
import-board-instruction-asana: Pēsiti ha JSON hū atu ʻo e ngaahi ngāue mei he Asana ({ "data": [...] } mei he hū atu ʻa Asana pe GET /tasks). ʻOku fakakulupu ʻa e ngaahi ngāue ki he ngaahi konga (memberships); ʻoku ʻalu ʻa e ngaahi ngāue kuo ʻosi ki he Kuo ʻosi.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Pēsiti ha JSON hū atu ʻo ha lisi ZenKit ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). ʻE hoko ʻa e ngaahi tuʻunga ko e ngaahi lisi pea ko e ngaahi meʻa ko e ngaahi kaati.
import-board-instruction-markdown: ʻAi ha lisi ngāue markdown (ko e founga ʻoku ngāueʻaki ʻe he ngaahi meʻangāue markdown-kanban hangē ko e Obsidian Kanban): ʻulumotuʻa "## Hingoa lisi", mo e ngaahi kōpite "- [ ]"/"- [x]" ʻi lalo. ʻOku hoko ʻa e ngaahi ʻulumotuʻa ko e ngaahi lisi pea hoko ʻa e ngaahi kōpite ko e ngaahi kaati.
import-board-instruction-leo: Fakapipiki ha faʻunga Leo (faile .leo). Ko e ngaahi konga ʻi he tuʻunga māʻolunga tahá ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi lisi, pea ko e ngaahi konga ʻoku ʻi lalo tonu ʻiate kinautolú ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi kaati, mo e tohi ʻo e kongá ko e fakamatala ʻo e kaatí. Ko e ngaahi konga ʻi he ngaahi tuʻunga loloto angé ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi lisi sivi. ʻOku hū mai ʻa e ngaahi konga kuo fakaʻilongaʻí ʻo pehē kuo ʻosi.
import-board-instruction-opml: Pēsiti ha fokotuʻutuʻu OPML, ʻo hangē ko hono ʻave ki tuʻa ʻe Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq mo e ngaahi polokalama fokotuʻutuʻu kehe. Ko e ngaahi meʻa ʻi he tuʻunga ʻolunga ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi lisi, ko ʻenau fānau ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi kaati mo e nouti ko e fakamatala fakaikiiki, pea ko e ngaahi meʻa ʻi lalo ange ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi lisi sivi. Ko e ngaahi meʻa kuo kakato ʻoku hū mai ko e kuo ʻosi.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Pēsiti ha faile Org mode, ʻo hangē ko hono tohi ʻe Emacs, Orgzly pe Beorg. Ko e ngaahi kaveinga ʻi he tuʻunga ʻolunga ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi lisi pea ko e ngaahi kaveinga ʻi he tuʻunga ua ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi kaati. ʻOku tauhi ʻa e TODO mo e DONE, ngaahi muʻomuʻa, ngaahi fakaʻilonga, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE mo e CLOSED, pea ko e ngaahi puha sivi mo e ngaahi kaveinga ʻi lalo ange ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi lisi sivi.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Fakapipiki ha faile todo.txt: ngāue ʻe taha ʻi he laine takitaha, ʻo hangē ko hono tohi ʻe he polokalama todo.txt mo e ngaahi polokalama ʻoku fehoanakí. ʻOku ʻalu ʻa e ngaahi ngāue kuo ʻosi ("x") ki he ʻOsi, hoko ʻa e +project mo e @context ko e ngaahi fakaʻilonga, hoko ʻa e (A) ko ha fakaʻilonga mahuʻinga, pea hoko ʻa e due: mo e t: ko e ʻaho fakaʻosi mo e ʻaho kamata.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Fakapipiki ʻa e ola ʻo e task export: ko ha lisi JSON pe ngāue ʻe taha ʻi he laine takitaha. ʻOku ʻalu ʻa e ngaahi ngāue kuo ʻosi ki he Done, pea hoko ʻa e project mo e priority ko e ngaahi fakaʻilonga, annotations ko e ngaahi fakamatala, pea depends ko e fakafalala ki he ngaahi ngāue ʻoku taʻofi kinautolu.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Fakaava ʻa e faile .boardarchive mei he zip pea fakapipiki ʻa e kanotohi ʻo e board.jsonl ʻo e papa, fakataha mo e laine ʻo e tatau pe ʻikai. ʻOku hoko ʻa e ʻulungaanga fakakulupu ʻo e vakai papa ko e ngaahi lisi, ngaahi ʻulungaanga fili kehe ko e ngaahi fakaʻilonga, ngaahi konga tohi mo e puha fakaʻilonga ko e fakamatala mo e lisi sivi, pea tauhi ʻa e ngaahi fakakaukau. ʻOku ʻikai fakahū mai ʻa e ngaahi ʻata mo e ngaahi faile fakapipiki.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: ʻI MeisterTask, lomiʻi ʻa e hingoa ʻo e poloseki, fili ʻa e Export project pea ʻave ki tuʻa ʻa e CSV, pea pēsiti ia. Ko e ngaahi konga ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi lisi pea ko e ngaahi ngāue ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi kaati, mo ʻenau ngaahi nouti, ʻaho ngataʻanga, tokotaha vahe mo e ngaahi fakaʻilonga; ko e ngaahi ngāue kuo kakato ʻoku tauhi ʻa honau ʻaho naʻe kakato ai. ʻOku ngāue foki ha CSV naʻe tohi ki he hū mai ʻa MeisterTask tonu.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: ʻI Obsidian, fakaava ʻa e faile ʻo e papa Kanban ko e Markdown (pe fakaava ʻa e faile .md ʻi ha polokalama fakatonutonu tohi), pea pēsiti ia kotoa. Ko e ngaahi hala ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi lisi mo honau ngaahi fakangatangata kaati, ko e ngaahi kaati ʻoku tauhi ʻa honau ngaahi fakaʻilonga, ʻaho, muʻomuʻa, ngaahi konga mo e lisi sivi, pea ko e Archive ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi kaati ʻi he tukuʻanga.
import-board-instruction-linear: ʻI Linear, ʻave ki tuʻa ʻa e ngaahi ʻīsiu ko e CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, pe ko e ʻave ki tuʻa ʻa ha vīsone), pea pēsiti ʻa e CSV. Ko e ngaahi tuʻunga ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi lisi, ko e ngaahi timi ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi hala, pea ko e ngaahi ʻīsiu ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi kaati mo honau tokotaha vahe, ngaahi fakaʻilonga, ʻaho, ʻīsiu tefito, muʻomuʻa, fakafuofua, poloseki mo e takai.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: ʻI TickTick, fakaava ʻa e Settings, Account, Backup & Import pea faʻu ha tatau malu, pea pēsiti ʻa e faile CSV. Ko e lisi TickTick takitaha ʻoku hoko ko ha hala pea ko hono ngaahi kōlomu ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi lisi; ko e ngaahi ngāue ʻoku tauhi ʻa honau ngaahi fakaʻilonga, ʻaho, lisi sivi, muʻomuʻa mo e ngaahi ngāue iiki.
import-board-instruction-clickup: ʻI ClickUp, ʻave ki tuʻa ʻa e ngaahi ngāue ko e CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, pe ko e ʻave ki tuʻa ʻa ha vīsone List pe Table mo e ngaahi kōlomu kotoa), pea pēsiti ʻa e CSV. Ko e ngaahi tuʻunga ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi lisi, ko e ngaahi lisi ClickUp ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi hala, pea ko e ngaahi ngāue ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi kaati mo ʻenau ngaahi ngāue iiki, kau vahe, ngaahi fakaʻilonga, ʻaho, muʻomuʻa mo e taimi.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: ʻI Nullboard, fakaava ʻa e papa, fili ʻa e Export this board... mei he lisi fili, fakaava ʻa e faile .nbx ʻi ha polokalama fakatonutonu tohi pea pēsiti hono ngaahi meʻa. Ko e ngaahi lisi ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi lisi pea ko e ngaahi nouti ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi kaati: ko e laine ʻuluaki ʻo ha nouti ko e hingoa ʻo e kaati pea ko e toenga ko hono fakamatala fakaikiiki. ʻOku maʻu ʻe ha nouti raw ʻa e fakaʻilonga raw. Ko ha faile mo ha ngaahi papa lahi ʻoku hū mai pē hono papa ʻuluaki.
import-board-instruction-kanri: ʻI Kanri, fakaava ʻa e Import & Export pea fili ʻa e Export individual board (pe Export all data), pea pēsiti ʻa e faile .json. Ko e ngaahi kōlomu ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi lisi pea ko e ngaahi kaati ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi kaati, mo honau fakamatala fakaikiiki, ʻaho ngataʻanga, ngaahi fakaʻilonga mo e ngaahi lanu; ko e ngaahi ngāue ʻo ha kaati ʻoku hoko ko ha lisi sivi. Mei ha ʻave ki tuʻa ʻo e ngaahi fakamatala kotoa ʻoku hū mai ʻa e papa ʻuluaki.
import-board-instruction-planka: Tohiʻi ʻa e tuasila ʻo hoʻo Planka (hangē ko e https://planka.example.com), mo ho hingoa ʻo e tokotaha ngāue mo e lea fufū ʻo Planka, pea lomiʻi ʻa e "Lisi". ʻOku ngāueʻaki pē kinautolu ke ʻomi ʻa e papa pea ʻoku ʻikai tauhi. Fili ha papa pea lomiʻi ʻa e "ʻOmi": ʻoku lau ia ʻe WeKan mei he API ʻo Planka, mo hono ngaahi lisi, kaati, fakamatala, ʻaho ngata, fakaʻilonga, kau mēmipa, lisi ngāue mo e ngaahi fakamatala, pea hokohoko atu ʻa e fakahū hangē ko e angamaheni. Ko e ngaahi kaati ʻi he tukuʻanga ʻo Planka ʻoku fakahū kuo tukuʻi; ko e ngaahi faile fakapipiki mo e kaati ʻi he kato veve ʻoku ʻikai fakahū.
import-board-instruction-mstodo: ʻI he Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer), hū ki loto, loto ki he ngofua Tasks.Read pea hiki ʻa e token mei he tab Access token. Fakapipiki heni pea lomiʻi ʻa e "Lisi"; ʻoku ngāueʻaki pē ʻa e token ki he ʻomi ko ʻeni pea ʻoku ʻikai tauhi. Fili ʻa e lisi kotoa pe ko e lisi ʻe taha pea lomiʻi ʻa e "ʻOmi". ʻOku hoko ʻa e lisi To Do takitaha ko e lisi pea ko e ngāue takitaha ko e kaati, mo hono ngaahi nouti, ʻaho ngata mo e ʻaho kamata, ngaahi sitepu ko e lisi sivi, ngaahi kalasi ko e fakaʻilonga, mahuʻinga lahi mo e tuʻunga ko e fakaʻilonga; ko e ngaahi ngāue kuo ʻosi ʻoku tukuʻi. ʻOku ʻikai fakahū ʻa e ngaahi fakamanatu mo e toe fai.
import-board-instruction-kanbanflow: ʻI he KanbanFlow, fakaava ʻa e menu ʻo e papa, fili ʻa e Settings → API & Webhooks pea hiki ʻa e API token ʻo e papa. Fakapipiki ʻa e token heni, lomiʻi ʻa e "Lisi", fili ʻa e papa pea lomiʻi ʻa e "ʻOmi"; ʻoku ngāueʻaki pē ʻa e token ki he ʻomi ko ia pea ʻoku ʻikai tauhi. ʻOku hoko ʻa e ngaahi kōlomu ko e lisi pea ʻoku nofo ʻa e ngaahi hala ko e hala; ʻoku tauhi ʻe he ngaahi ngāue ʻenau fakamatala, lanu, fakaʻilonga, ʻaho ngata, ngāue siʻi ko e lisi sivi, taimi naʻe ngāueʻaki, fakafuofua, kakai mo e ngaahi fakamatala.
import-board-instruction-basecamp: Tohiʻi ʻa e ID ʻo hoʻo ʻakauni Basecamp (ko e fika hili ʻa e basecamp.com/ ʻi he tuasila) mo ha token hū (mei ha app OAuth 2 kuo lesisita ʻi he launchpad.37signals.com, pe ko ha token ʻoku ʻi ai kiate ha fakahokohoko ʻoku ʻi ai), lomiʻi ʻa e "Lisi", fili ha poloseki pea lomiʻi ʻa e "ʻOmi". ʻOku ngāueʻaki pē ʻa e token ki he ʻomi ko ia pea ʻoku ʻikai tauhi. ʻOku hoko ʻa e tēpile kaati takitaha ko e hala mo hono ngaahi kōlomu ko e lisi, pea ko e ngaahi lisi ke fai ʻoku hoko ko e hala "To-dos"; ʻoku tauhi ʻe he kaati mo e ngaahi me'a ke fai ʻa e tohi, ʻaho, kakai kuo vaheʻi mo e fakamatala, ko e ngaahi sitepu ʻo ha kaati ʻoku hoko ko e lisi sivi, pea ko e ngaahi meʻa kuo ʻosi ʻoku tukuʻi.
import-board-instruction-googletasks: Maʻu ha token hū mei he OAuth 2.0 Playground: ʻi lalo ʻi he Tasks API v1 fili ʻa e tasks.readonly, lomiʻi ʻa e Authorize APIs, pea Exchange authorization code for tokens, pea hiki ʻa e access token. Fakapipiki heni pea lomiʻi ʻa e "Lisi", fili ʻa e lisi ngāue kotoa pe taha, pea "ʻOmi". ʻOku ngāueʻaki pē ʻa e token ki he ʻomi ko ʻeni pea ʻoku ʻikai tauhi. ʻOku hoko ʻa e ngaahi lisi ngāue ko e lisi pea ko e ngaahi ngāue ko e kaati, mo honau nouti, ngaahi link mo e ʻaho ngata; ko e ngāue siʻi ʻoku hoko ko e lisi sivi pea ko e ngaahi ngāue kuo ʻosi ʻoku fakahū kuo tukuʻi.
import-board-instruction-googlekeep: Ko e API ʻo Google Keep ʻoku maʻa e ngaahi ʻakauni Google Workspace pē. Maʻu ha token hū OAuth 2.0 mo e scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/keep.readonly (ʻi he OAuth 2.0 Playground kapau ʻoku fakangofua ʻe hoʻo pule Workspace, pe mei ha service account mo e fakafofonga ʻo e domain kotoa), fakapipiki, lomiʻi ʻa e "Lisi" pea "ʻOmi". ʻOku ngāueʻaki pē ʻa e token ki he ʻomi ko ʻeni pea ʻoku ʻikai tauhi. ʻOku hoko ʻa e ngaahi nouti tohi ko e kaati ʻi he lisi "Notes", pea ko e ngaahi nouti lisi sivi ʻoku hoko ko e kaati ʻi he lisi "Lists" mo honau ngaahi meʻa ko e lisi sivi. ʻOku ʻikai fakahū ʻa e ngaahi nouti ʻi he veve, faile fakapipiki mo e vahevahe.
api-import-desc: ʻOmi ia mei he sēvesi ʻaki hoʻo ʻakauni pē ʻaʻau. Ko e meʻa ʻoku ke tohiʻi heni ʻoku ngāueʻaki pē ki he ʻomi ko ʻeni pea ʻoku ʻikai tauhi.
api-import-fetched: Kuo ʻomi. Vakaiʻi ʻa e kau mēmipa ʻi lalo pea fakahū.
api-import-failed: Naʻe ʻikai lava ʻa e ʻomi
api-import-nothing: ʻOku ʻikai ha meʻa ke fakahū ʻaki ʻa e ʻakauni ko ʻeni.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: ʻI Pivotal Tracker, fakaava ʻa e konga MORE ʻo e poloseki pea fili ʻa e Export CSV (pe fili ha ngaahi talanoa pea fili ʻa e Bulk Actions, CSV), pea pēsiti ʻa e CSV. Ko e tuʻunga talanoa takitaha ʻoku hoko ko ha lisi pea ko e ngaahi talanoa ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi kaati, mo honau faʻahinga mo e ngaahi fakaʻilonga, kau ʻona, tokotaha kole, ʻaho, ngaahi fakamatala, ngaahi ngāue mo e ngaahi meʻa taʻofi; ko e Estimate ʻoku hoko ko e Story points pea ko e ngaahi takai ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi sprint.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: ʻI Tasks.org, fakaava ʻa e Settings, Backups pea fili ʻa e Export tasks, pea pēsiti ʻa e ngaahi meʻa ʻo e faile .json ko ia. Ko e ngaahi lisi ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi lisi pea ko e ngaahi ngāue ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi kaati, mo ʻenau ngaahi nouti, ngaahi fakaʻilonga, ʻaho, ngaahi fakamatala mo e ngaahi ngāue iiki; ko e ngaahi ngāue kuo kakato ʻoku tauhi ʻa honau ʻaho naʻe kakato ai, pea ko e muʻomuʻa ʻoku hoko ko ha konga fakafoʻituitui.
import-board-instruction-monday: ʻI monday.com, fakaava ʻa e lisi fili ʻo e papa, fili ʻa e More actions mo e Export board to Excel (mo e ngaahi fakaʻosi mo e ngaahi meʻa iiki kapau ʻoku ke loto ki ai), pea fili ʻa e faile .xlsx ko ia. Ko e kōlomu Status ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi lisi pea ko e ngaahi kulupu ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi hala; ko e kakai, ʻaho, laine taimi mo e ngaahi fakaʻilonga ʻoku tauhi ʻa honau feituʻu, ko e ngaahi kōlomu kehe ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi konga fakafoʻituitui pea ko e ngaahi fakaʻosi ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi fakamatala.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: ʻI Super Productivity, fakaava ʻa e Settings, pea ko e Sync & Backup, fili ʻa e Export Data pea pēsiti ʻa e ngaahi meʻa ʻo e faile sp-backup .json. Ko e poloseki takitaha ʻoku hoko ko ha hala pea ko e ngaahi ngāue ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi kaati ʻi he To Do, In Progress, Backlog pe Done, mo ʻenau ngaahi nouti, ngaahi fakaʻilonga, ʻaho ngataʻanga, taimi naʻe ngāueʻaki mo e ngaahi ngāue iiki; ko e ngaahi ngāue ʻi he tukuʻanga ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi kaati ʻi he tukuʻanga.
import-board-instruction-taiga: ʻI Taiga, fakaava ʻa e Admin > Project > Export pea feʻaveaki hifo ʻa e tatau ʻo e poloseki (vete ʻuluaki ha faile .json.gz), pea pēsiti hono JSON. Ko e ngaahi tuʻunga ʻo e talanoa ʻa e tokotaha ngāueʻaki ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi lisi, ko e ngaahi talanoa ʻa e tokotaha ngāueʻaki ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi kaati mo ʻenau ngaahi ngāue ko e ngaahi ngāue iiki, ko e ngaahi epic mo e ngaahi ʻīsiu ʻoku maʻu honau hala pē ʻonautolu, pea ʻoku haʻu mo e ngaahi sprint, ngaahi fakaʻilonga, ngaahi fakamatala mo e ngaahi ʻulungaanga fakafoʻituitui. ʻOku ʻikai hū mai ʻa e ngaahi meʻa fakapipiki.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: ʻI Vikunja, fakaava ʻa e Settings, fili ʻa e Data Export pea feʻaveaki hifo ʻa e faile .zip ʻoku ne ʻave atu kiate koe, pea fili ʻa e faile ko ia, pe pēsiti ʻa e data.json ʻoku ʻi loto ai. Ko e ngaahi kakato Kanban ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi lisi pea ko e ngaahi ngāue ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi kaati, mo ʻenau ngaahi fakaʻilonga, kau vahe, ʻaho, fakamatala fakaikiiki, ngaahi lisi ngāue ko e ngaahi lisi sivi mo e ngaahi fakamatala; ko e muʻomuʻa, peseti kuo ʻosi mo e kuo ʻosi ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi konga fakafoʻituitui. ʻOku ʻikai hū mai ʻa e ngaahi meʻa fakapipiki.
import-board-instruction-quire: ʻI Quire, fakaava ʻa e lisi fili ʻo e poloseki pea fili ʻa e Export CSV, pea pēsiti ʻa e CSV. Ko e ngaahi tuʻunga ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi lisi pea ko e ngaahi ngāue ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi kaati, mo ʻenau ngaahi ngāue iiki ko e ngaahi kaati fānau, kau vahe, ngaahi fakaʻilonga, ʻaho kamata, ngataʻanga mo e kakato, fakamatala fakaikiiki mo e muʻomuʻa ko ha konga fakafoʻituitui. ʻOku ʻikai ʻi he CSV ʻa Quire ʻa e ngaahi fakamatala mo e ngaahi meʻa fakapipiki.
import-board-instruction-wrike: ʻI Wrike, ʻave ki tuʻa ha poloseki pe fōlota ki he Excel, pe fakafonu ʻa e sīpinga hū mai Excel ʻa Wrike, pea fili ʻa e faile .xlsx ko ia. Ko e ngaahi laine fōlota mo e poloseki ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi hala, ko e Status ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi lisi pea ko e ngaahi ngāue ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi kaati, mo honau Key, ngāue tefito, kau vahe, ʻaho kamata mo e ngataʻanga, ngaahi falalaʻanga mo e fakamatala fakaikiiki; ko e Priority, Duration mo e ngaahi kōlomu kehe ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi konga fakafoʻituitui.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: ʻI Teamwork.com, fakafonu ʻa e sīpinga hū mai ngāue Excel (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) pea tauhi ia ko e .xlsx, pea fili ʻa e faile ko ia. Ko e ngaahi lisi ngāue ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi lisi pea ko e ngaahi ngāue ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi kaati; ko ha ngāue ʻoku kamata ʻaki ʻa e -, # pe > ʻoku hoko ko ha ngāue iiki ʻo e ngāue ʻi ʻolunga ʻiate ia (--, ## pe >> ko ha tuʻunga ʻe taha ʻi lalo ange). Ko e kau vahe, ʻaho mo e ngaahi fakaʻilonga ʻoku tauhi ʻa honau feituʻu; ko e Priority, Estimated time mo e Complete ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi konga fakafoʻituitui.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: ʻI Businessmap (naʻe ui ko Kanbanize), fakaava ʻa e Advanced Search, fili ʻa e Configure results ke fili ʻa e ngaahi kōlomu, feʻaveaki hifo ʻa e faile Excel, pea fili ʻa e faile .xlsx ko ia. ʻOku lau ʻa e ngaahi kōlomu ʻaki honau hingoa faka-Pilitānia (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): kapau ʻoku ngāueʻaki ʻe hoʻo ʻakauni ha lea kehe, liliu ʻuluaki ʻa e laine kaveinga ki he faka-Pilitānia. Ko e Column ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi lisi pea ko e Lane ko e ngaahi hala; ko e kau ʻona, ngaahi fakaʻilonga, lanu, ʻaho, ngaahi fakamatala mo e ngaahi fehokotakiʻanga tefito ʻoku tauhi ʻa honau feituʻu, pea ko e Priority, Size, Type mo e ngaahi kōlomu kehe ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi konga fakafoʻituitui.
import-board-instruction-redmine: ʻI Redmine, fakaava ʻa e Issues ʻo e poloseki, fili ʻa e Also available in: CSV ʻi lalo ʻo e lisi, fili ʻa e ngaahi kōlomu (All columns, mo e Description) pea ʻave ki tuʻa, pea pēsiti ʻa e CSV. ʻOku fakahingoa ʻe Redmine ʻa e ngaahi kōlomu ʻi hoʻo lea, ko ia fokotuʻu hoʻo lea ki he faka-Pilitānia ʻi he My account ki muʻa ke ʻave ki tuʻa. Ko e tuʻunga takitaha ʻoku hoko ko ha lisi pea ko e ngaahi ʻīsiu ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi kaati, mo e tracker ko ha fakaʻilonga, tokotaha vahe, tokotaha faʻu, ʻaho, ngāue tefito mo e ngaahi ʻīsiu fekauʻaki; ko e muʻomuʻa, kalasi, tatau taumuʻa, taimi fakafuofua, % Done mo e ngaahi konga fakafoʻituitui ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi konga fakafoʻituitui.
import-board-instruction-notion: ʻI Notion, fakaava ʻa e tānaki fakamatala ko ha peesi kakato, fili ʻa e ••• mo e Export, fili ʻa e Markdown & CSV, pea fili ʻa e faile .zip ʻoku ne feʻaveaki hifo, pe ko ha CSV ʻo ha tānaki fakamatala ʻe taha mei ai, pe pēsiti ʻa e CSV ko ia. Ko ha kōlomu ʻoku ui ko Status ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi lisi (kapau ʻoku ʻikai ha meʻa pehē, ko e kōlomu ʻuluaki ʻoku hangē ko ha fili, pea ʻoku fakahā ʻe he lipooti hū mai pe ko e fē); ko e ngaahi laine ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi kaati mo honau hingoa, ngaahi fakaʻilonga, kakai ko e kau mēmipa, ʻaho, pea mo e tohi ʻo e peesi ko e fakamatala fakaikiiki; ko e ngaahi kōlomu kehe ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi konga fakafoʻituitui. ʻOku ʻikai hū mai ʻa e ngaahi fekauʻaki, ngaahi ʻīmisi mo e ngaahi meʻa fakapipiki.
import-board-instruction-plane: ʻI Plane, fakaava ʻa e Workspace Settings, fili ʻa e Exports, ʻave ki tuʻa ʻa e ngaahi poloseki ko e JSON, CSV pe Excel pea feʻaveaki hifo ʻa e faile .zip, pea fili ʻa e faile ko ia, pe ko ha faile ʻe taha mei loto ai, pe pēsiti ʻa e JSON pe CSV. Ko e ngaahi tuʻunga ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi lisi, ko e ngaahi poloseki ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi hala, pea ko e ngaahi ʻīsiu ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi kaati mo honau fakaʻilonga tefito, meʻa tefito, kau vahe, ngaahi fakaʻilonga, ʻaho, ngaahi fehokotakiʻanga mo e ngaahi fakamatala; ko e muʻomuʻa, fakafuofua, takai mo e mōtule ʻoku hoko ko e ngaahi konga fakafoʻituitui. ʻOku ʻikai ha ngaahi fakamatala fakaikiiki pe meʻa fakapipiki ʻi he ʻave ki tuʻa ʻa Plane, ko ia ʻoku ʻikai hū mai ia.
import-board-instruction-trello: ʻI hoʻo papa Trello, ʻalu ki he 'Menu', pea 'More', 'Print and Export', 'Export JSON', pea kopi ʻa e tohi ʻoku maʻu mai.
import-board-instruction-csv: Pēsiti hoʻo Comma Separated Values(CSV)/ Tab Separated Values (TSV) .
import-board-instruction-jira: Pēsiti ʻa e JSON ʻo ha kumi palopalema ʻi he Jira Cloud: GET /rest/api/3/search/jql?jql=project=KEY&fields=*all&expand=names,schema (kapau ʻoku ʻikai ha fields ʻoku ne foki mai pē ʻa e ngaahi id ʻo e palopalema). ʻOku haʻu ha poloseki lahi ʻi he ngaahi peesi, ʻoku ʻi he taki taha ha nextPageToken ki he hoko: ʻai ʻa e ngaahi palopalema ʻo e peesi kotoa ki ha fakahokohoko "issues" ʻe taha, pe hū mai ʻa e peesi takitaha ko hano papa pē ʻaki ʻa e Hū mai ha ngaahi papa lahi. ʻOku ngāue foki ha meʻa { "issues": [...] } ʻoku tatau. ʻE hoko ʻa e ngaahi tuʻunga Jira ko e ngaahi lisi pea ko e ngaahi palopalema ko e ngaahi kaati. Kapau ʻoku ke loto, fakakau ha fakahokohoko "automationRules" ke hū mai ʻa e ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni.
import-board-instruction-excel: Fili ha tohi ngāue .xlsx: ko ha tēpile ʻoku kaati ʻe taha ʻi he laine takitaha (ngaahi kolomu hangē ko e Hingoa, Fakamatala, Tuʻunga/Lisi, Kau mēmipa, Ngaahi fakaʻilonga, ngaahi ʻaho mo e ngaahi konga fakafoʻituitui), pe ko ha tohi ngāue naʻe hū atu ʻe WeKan, ʻo kau ai mo ha taha ʻoku ʻi ai ʻa e papa takitaha ʻi hono laʻipepa pē. ʻOku fakahā ʻe he sitepu hoko ʻa e kolomu ko e fē ʻa e konga ko e fē. ʻE hoko ʻa e laʻipepa kotoa ʻoku ʻi ai ha laine ʻulu ko ha papa.
import-board-instruction-wekan: ʻI hoʻo papa, ʻalu ki he 'Menu', pea 'Hū atu ʻa e papa', pea kopi ʻa e tohi ʻi he faile naʻe hiki mai.
import-board-instruction-about-errors: Kapau ʻoku ke maʻu ha ngaahi fehalaaki ʻi hono hū mai ʻo e papa, ʻi he taimi ʻe niʻihi ʻoku kei lava pē ʻa e hū mai, pea ʻoku ʻi he peesi Ngaahi papa kotoa ʻa e papa.
import-without-mapping-members: Hū mai taʻe fakahoa ʻa e kau mēmipa (fakahoa ʻamui)
import-members-mode-map: Fili ha tokotaha ngāueʻaki ʻoku ʻi ai ki he tokotaha takitaha
import-members-mode-placeholder: Tauhi kinautolu ko e kau ngāueʻaki fakataimi mo honau hingoa pē ʻonautolu, ke fakahoa ki he kau ngāueʻaki moʻoni ʻamui
csv-mapping-title: Ko e kōlomu fē ʻoku fē?
csv-mapping-description: Fili ʻa e kōlomu ʻo e faile ʻoku ʻi ai ʻa e konga kaati takitaha. Naʻe fili ʻa e ngaahi fili mei he ngaahi hingoa kōlomu; liliu ha meʻa ʻoku hala, pea fili ʻa e (ʻikai ʻi he faile) ki ha konga ʻoku ʻikai ʻi he faile.
csv-mapping-list-missing: ʻOku ʻikai ha kōlomu ʻi he faile ki he lisi. Fili ha taha ʻi ʻolunga, pe tohi ʻa e hingoa ʻo e lisi ʻe taha ʻoku ʻalu ki ai ʻa e kaati kotoa pē.
csv-mapping-list-name: Lisi ki he kaati kotoa pē
csv-mapping-custom-fields: Ngaahi kōlomu kehe ke hū mai ko e ngaahi konga fakafoʻituitui tohi:
csv-mapping-boards: Ko e laʻipepa takitaha ʻoku hoko ko hono papa pē ʻoʻona:
csv-mapping-skipped-sheets: Ngaahi laʻipepa ʻoku ʻikai hū mai:
csv-mapping-title-required: Fili ʻa e kōlomu ʻoku ʻi ai ʻa e ngaahi hingoa kaati.
csv-mapping-list-required: Tohi ʻa e hingoa ʻo e lisi ʻoku ʻalu ki ai ʻa e kaati kotoa pē, pe fili ʻa e kōlomu ʻoku ʻi ai ʻa e lisi.
invalid-import-mapping: ʻOku ʻikai tatau ʻa e fakahoa kōlomu mo e faile.
import-many-boards: Hū mai ha ngaahi papa lahi
import-many-boards-hint: Fili ha ngaahi faile ʻave ki tuʻa lahi ʻo e meʻangāue ko ʻeni, pe ko ha .zip ʻe taha ʻoku ʻi ai kinautolu: ko e faile takitaha ʻoku hoko ko hono papa pē ʻoʻona, ʻo hū mai taʻe fakahoa ʻa e kau mēmipa. Ko ha .zip ʻoku ko ha ʻave ki tuʻa ʻe taha pē (Vikunja, Notion, Plane, pe WeKan mo e ngaahi meʻa fakapipiki) ko ha papa ʻe taha. ʻI hono fili ʻa e ngaahi faile ʻi heni, ʻoku hū mai ʻe he Import ʻa kinautolu ʻo fetongi ʻa e konga ʻi ʻolunga.
import-one-board-per-project: Papa ʻe taha ki he poloseki takitaha
import-one-board-per-project-hint: Ko e hala takitaha ʻe faʻu ʻe he hū mai (ko ha poloseki, fōlota pe lisi ʻo e meʻangāue) ʻoku hoko ko hono papa pē ʻoʻona. Ko e ngaahi kaati tefito mo e ngaahi falalaʻanga ʻi he vahaʻa ʻo e ngaahi papa ko ia ʻoku lisi ʻi he lipooti hū mai.
import-many-progress: ʻOku hū mai ʻa e __done__ ʻo e __total__: __name__
export-all-boards: ʻAve ki tuʻa ʻa e ngaahi papa kotoa
export-selected-boards: ʻAve ki tuʻa ʻa e ngaahi papa kuo fili
export-all-boards-hint: Ko e papa kotoa pē ʻoku ke lava ʻo ʻave ki tuʻa, ʻi he feʻaveaki hifo ʻe taha: Excel ko ha tohi ngāue ʻe taha mo ha laʻipepa ki he papa takitaha ʻoku fakahingoa ʻaki ia, pea ko e ngaahi founga kehe kotoa ko ha .zip mo ha faile ki he papa takitaha.
exportAllBoardsPopup-title: ʻAve ki tuʻa ʻa e ngaahi papa kotoa
import-json-placeholder: Pēsiti heni hoʻo fakamatala JSON totonu
import-csv-placeholder: Pēsiti heni hoʻo fakamatala CSV/TSV totonu
import-json-file: Pe fili ha faile JSON ʻo e Trello

r-wrike-workflow-note: Ko ha founga ngāue Wrike ko ha lisi ʻo e ngaahi tuʻunga, ʻa ia ʻoku takitaha ʻi he kulupu Active, Completed, Deferred pe Cancelled. ʻOku tohi ʻe he ʻave ki tuʻa ʻa e ngaahi lisi ʻo e papa ko ʻeni ko e taha, ʻoku fakahingoa ʻaki ʻa e papa, ʻi he JSON ʻoku fakafoki ʻe he API ʻa Wrike ki he ngaahi founga ngāue: faʻu ʻa e founga ngāue ko ia ʻi Wrike ki muʻa ke hū mai ʻa e ʻave ki tuʻa Excel Wrike ʻo e papa, koeʻuhi ke ngāueʻaki hono ngaahi tuʻunga. ʻOku lau ʻe he hū mai ʻa e JSON ko ia kuo pēsiti ʻi ʻolunga, mei WeKan pe mei he GET /workflows ʻa Wrike, ki he papa kuo fili: ko ha tuʻunga ʻoku ʻikai hano lisi ʻoku hoko ko ha lisi, pea ʻoku fakaʻilongaʻi ʻe ha tuʻutuʻuni ha kaati ko e kakato ʻi hono hiki ki ha tuʻunga Completed pe Cancelled pea ʻikai kakato ʻi ha tuʻunga Active pe Deferred. ʻOku ʻikai lava ke ʻave ki tuʻa mei Wrike ʻa e ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni fakaʻotomētiki ʻa Wrike tonu.

globalSearch-instructions-description: ʻE lava ke ʻi ai ha ngaahi opalēta ʻi he kumi ke fakaleleiʻi ʻa e kumi.  ʻOku fakahā ʻa e ngaahi opalēta ʻaki hono tohi ʻa e hingoa opalēta mo e mahuʻinga vahevahe ʻaki ha koloni.  Hangē ko ʻeni, ko e opalēta `lisi:Taʻofi` ʻe fakangatangata ai ʻa e kumi ki he ngaahi kaati ʻoku ʻi ha lisi ʻoku hingoa ko *Taʻofi*.  Kapau ʻoku ʻi ai ha ngaahi vahaʻa pe ngaahi mataʻitohi makehe ʻi he mahuʻinga, kuo pau ke kofukofu ia ʻaki ha ngaahi fakaʻilonga lea (hangē ko e `__operator_list__:"Ke Vakaiʻi"`).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-board: `__operator_board__:<title>` - ngaahi kaati ʻi he ngaahi papa ʻoku fehoanaki mo e *<title>* kuo fakahā
globalSearch-instructions-operator-list: `__operator_list__:<title>` - ngaahi kaati ʻi he ngaahi lisi ʻoku fehoanaki mo e *<title>* kuo fakahā
globalSearch-instructions-operator-swiml: `__operator_swimlane__:<title>` - ngaahi kaati ʻi he ngaahi hala ʻoku fehoanaki mo e *<title>* kuo fakahā
globalSearch-instructions-operator-comme: `__operator_comment__:<text>` - ngaahi kaati mo ha fakamatala ʻoku ʻi ai ʻa e *<text>*.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-label: `__operator_label__:<color>` `__operator_label__:<name>` - ngaahi kaati ʻoku ʻi ai ha fakaʻilonga ʻoku fehoanaki mo e *<color>* pe *<name>
globalSearch-instructions-operator-user: `__operator_user__:<username>` - ngaahi kaati ʻoku *mēmipa* ai pe *kuo tuku ki ai* ʻa e *<username>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-membe: `__operator_member__:<username>` - ngaahi kaati ʻoku *mēmipa* ai ʻa e *<username>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-assig: `__operator_assignee__:<username>` - ngaahi kaati ʻoku *tuku ki ai* ʻa e *<username>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_creator__:<username>` - ngaahi kaati ko e *<username>* naʻa ne faʻu ʻa e kaati
globalSearch-instructions-operator-org: `__operator_org__:<display name|short name>` - ngaahi kaati ʻoku ʻi ha papa kuo tuku ki he kautaha *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-team: `__operator_team__:<display name|short name>` - ngaahi kaati ʻoku ʻi ha papa kuo tuku ki he timi *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - ngaahi kaati ʻoku ngata ʻi loto ʻi he ʻaho ʻe *<n>* mei he taimí ni.  `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ ʻoku lisi ʻa e ngaahi kaati kotoa kuo hili honau ʻaho ngataʻanga.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - ngaahi kaati naʻe fakatupu ʻi he ʻaho ʻe *<n>* kuo hili pe siʻi ange
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - ngaahi kaati naʻe liliu ʻi he ʻaho ʻe *<n>* kuo hili pe siʻi ange
globalSearch-instructions-operator-statu: `__operator_status__:<status>` - ʻa ia ko e *<status>* ko e taha ʻo e ngaahi meʻa ko ʻeni:
globalSearch-instructions-status-all: `__predicate_all__` - ngaahi kaati kotoa ʻi he tukuʻanga mo ia ʻoku ʻikai ʻi he tukuʻanga
globalSearch-instructions-status-ended: `__predicate_ended__` - ngaahi kaati ʻoku ʻi ai hano ʻaho ngata
globalSearch-instructions-status-public: `__predicate_public__` - ngaahi kaati ʻi he ngaahi papa fakakakai pē
globalSearch-instructions-status-private: `__predicate_private__` - ngaahi kaati ʻi he ngaahi papa fakafoʻituitui pē
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - ʻa ia ko e *<field>* ko e taha ʻo e `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` pe `__predicate_member__`.  Ko hono tuku ha `-` ʻi muʻa ʻi he *<field>* ʻoku kumi ai ki he ʻikai ha mahuʻinga ʻi he malaʻe ko ia (hangē ko e `mau:-ngataanga` ʻoku kumi ki he ngaahi kaati ʻoku ʻikai ha ʻaho ngataʻanga).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - ʻa ia ko e *<sort-name>* ko e taha ʻo e `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` pe `__predicate_modified__`.  Ki ha fakahokohoko fakasiʻisiʻi, tuku ha `-` ʻi muʻa ʻi he hingoa fakahokohoko.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - ʻa ia ko e *<n>* ko ha fika kakato lahi ange ʻi he noa ʻoku fakahā ai ʻa e fika ʻo e ngaahi kaati ke fakahā ʻi he peesi taki taha.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-1: ʻE lava ke fakahā ha ngaahi opalēta lahi.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
ʻOku fakataha ʻaki ʻa e *PE* ʻa e ngaahi opalēta tatau.  ʻE fakafoki mai ʻa e ngaahi kaati ʻoku fehoanaki mo ha taha ʻo e ngaahi tuʻunga.
`__operator_list__:ʻAtā __operator_list__:Taʻofi` ʻe fakafoki mai ai ʻa e ngaahi kaati ʻoku ʻi ha lisi ʻoku hingoa ko *Taʻofi* pe *ʻAtā*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: ʻOku fakataha ʻaki ʻa e *MO* ʻa e ngaahi opalēta kehekehe.  Ko e ngaahi kaati pē ʻoku fehoanaki mo e ngaahi opalēta kehekehe kotoa ʻoku fakafoki mai.  `__operator_list__:ʻAtā __operator_label__:kulokula` ʻoku fakafoki mai pē ai ʻa e ngaahi kaati ʻi he lisi *ʻAtā* mo ha fakaʻilonga *kulokula*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: ʻE lava ke fakahā ʻa e ngaahi ʻaho ko ha fika kakato lahi ange pe siʻi ange ʻi he noa pe ʻaki ʻa e `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` pe `__predicate_year__` ki he vahaʻa taimi lolotonga.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-4: ʻOku ʻikai tokanga ʻa e kumi tohi ki he mataʻitohi lahi pe siʻi.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: ʻI he tuʻunga angamaheni ʻoku ʻikai kumi ʻa e ngaahi kaati ʻi he tukuʻanga.

database-migration-description: Hiki ʻa e fakamatala tohi (meʻa kotoa tuku kehe ʻa e ngaahi meʻa fakahoko mo e ʻata fakafofonga, ʻa ia ʻoku nofo ʻi he sisitemi faile) ʻi he vahaʻa ʻo e MongoDB mo e FerretDB v1 (SQLite). Kuo pau ke lele mo aʻu ki ai ʻa e tauhiʻanga fakamatala ʻe taha (ngaahi poate tuʻumaʻu: FerretDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018, MongoDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27019; liliu ʻaki ʻa e WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL). Hili hono ʻosi, tuhu ʻa e MONGO_URL ki he tauhiʻanga fakamatala ʻe taha pea toe kamata ʻa e WeKan (ʻi he Snap: snap set wekan database=ferretdb pe =mongodb).

sandstorm-migration-description: ʻI he lele ʻa e WeKan ʻi loto ʻi ha grain Sandstorm, ʻoku hiki hono tauhiʻanga fakamatala motuʻa MongoDB 3 ki he FerretDB v1 (SQLite) ʻi he ʻuluaki kamata, pea ʻoku hiki ʻa e ngaahi meʻa fakahoko mo e ʻata fakafofonga mei he tauhiʻanga fakamatala ki he ngaahi kaha files/attachments mo files/avatars ʻo e grain. ʻOku fakahāhā heni pe naʻe lavameʻa ʻa e hiki ko ia mo e lahi ʻo e vahaʻa tisi ʻoku kei ngāueʻaki ʻe he ngaahi faile motuʻa ʻo e tauhiʻanga fakamatala MongoDB ʻi loto ʻi he grain, pea ʻoku ne tuku ke ke tāmateʻi ʻa e ngaahi faile ko ia ke fakaataʻatā ha vahaʻa.

sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-description: Hili ha hiki lavameʻa ʻoku nofo ʻa e fakamatala ʻi he FerretDB mo e sisitemi faile, ko ia ʻe lava ke tāmateʻi ʻa e ngaahi faile motuʻa ʻo e tauhiʻanga fakamatala MongoDB 3 ke fakaataʻatā ha vahaʻa tisi ʻo e grain. ʻOku ʻikai lava ke toe fakafoki eni.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-confirm: Tāmateʻi ʻa e ngaahi faile motuʻa ʻo e tauhiʻanga fakamatala MongoDB 3 ke fakaataʻatā ha vahaʻa tisi? Kuo ʻosi hiki ʻa e fakamatala ki he FerretDB mo e sisitemi faile. ʻOku ʻikai lava ke toe fakafoki eni.
sandstorm-raw-mongodb-deleted: Kuo tāmateʻi ʻa e ngaahi faile motuʻa ʻo e tauhiʻanga fakamatala MongoDB, kuo fakaataʻatā
features-desc: Ngaahi me'a ke fili ke ngāue'aki 'oku 'omi 'e WeKan. 'Oku fufū mei he kau ngāue'aki kotoa 'a e me'a na'e 'ikai fili. 'Oku kei tauhi hono fakamatala pea 'oku 'ikai liliu 'a e ngaahi ngofua.
feature-views-table-desc: Ko e papa hangē ha tēpile 'o e ngaahi kaati 'e lava ke fakahokohoko.
feature-views-calendar-desc: Tohimāhina mo e tohimāhina ki he ngaahi papa lahi.
feature-views-overview-desc: Ngaahi fika, fakakulupu fakatatau ki he tokotaha kuo vahe ki ai, palani ngāue, papa vakai'i ngāue mo e papa lahi.
feature-views-gantt-desc: Ko e ngaahi vakai 'e tolu 'o e saati Gantt.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Ngāue ki he koloa 'oku kei toe, ngaahi vaha'a taimi ngāue nounou, līpooti 'o e vaha'a taimi mo e vave 'o e ngāue.
feature-views-flow-charts: Ngaahi saati 'o e lele 'a e ngāue
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Ngāue 'oku toe, ngāue kuo 'osi, lele 'a e ngāue kuo fakatahataha'i, taimi takai mo e taimi mei he kole ki he 'osi, lahi 'o e ngāue kuo 'osi, taimi kuo tatali ai e ngāue, ngaahi fakafe'ātungia, Monte Carlo mo e ngaahi fua kehe 'o e lele 'a e ngāue.
feature-views-map-desc: Ngaahi kaati hangē ha faka'ilonga 'i ha 'ata kuo 'oatu.
feature-approval-required: Tuku ke tāmate'i 'a e ngaahi me'a kuo tānaki 'e he ngaahi fakalelei 'o WeKan kae 'oua kuo fakamo'ui 'e ha pule
feature-preview-admins: 'Oku sio 'a e kau pule ki he ngaahi me'a kuo tāmate'i ke nau 'uluaki 'ahi'ahi'i
feature-pilot-users: Kau ngāue'aki 'ahi'ahi 'oku nau sio foki ki he ngaahi me'a kuo tāmate'i
feature-pilot-users-placeholder: Ngaahi hingoa 'o e kau ngāue'aki, vahevahe 'aki e koma
feature-pilot-users-unknown: Kuo tauhi. Na'e 'ikai ma'u 'a e ngaahi hingoa 'o e kau ngāue'aki ni:
card-field-visibility-desc: Ko e ngaahi konga ʻo e Ngaahi fokotuʻutuʻu ʻo e papa / Kaati ʻe lava ke fakahā ʻe he ngaahi papa. Ko ha konga ʻoku ʻikai fakaʻilongaʻi ʻoku fufū ia mei he kaati kotoa pē, kaati iiki mo e Ngaahi fokotuʻutuʻu ʻo e papa / Kaati ʻo e papa kotoa pē. ʻOku ʻikai liliu ha fakamatala kaati pe fokotuʻutuʻu papa, pea ko hono toe fakaʻilongaʻi ʻoku fakahā ʻa e papa takitaha ʻo hangē ko hono fokotuʻu. Ko e hokohoko ʻo e ngaahi konga ʻoku ʻa e papa takitaha pē.
cards-loading: Hū mai ʻo e ngaahi kaati
cards-loading-auto: Fakaʻatamai (fakatuai pē ki he ngaahi papa lalahi)
cards-loading-lazy: Fakatuai (ko e ngaahi kaati pē ʻoku hāmai)
cards-loading-description: ʻOku fakahū fakaʻatamai ʻe he WeKan ʻa e ngaahi kaati ʻo e papa: ko ha papa lahi (ʻoku laka ʻi he ngataʻanga lahi) ʻoku fakahū pē ʻa e ngaahi kaati ʻoku hāmai he taimí ni (sikolo taʻengata) mo ha lau moʻui, ko ia ʻoku kei vave pea siʻi ange ʻa e manatu mo e bandwidth ʻoku ngāueʻaki, lolotonga ʻoku fakahū ʻe he ngaahi papa siʻisiʻi ange ʻa e kaati kotoa ki ha aʻusia faingofua mo kakato taha. ʻOku ʻikai ha meʻa ke fokotuʻutuʻu. ʻE kei lava ʻe he kau pule ke fakamālohi ha founga ʻaki ʻa e ngaahi variable ʻātakai CARDS_LOADING (all/lazy/auto) mo CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD.
cards-loading-lazy-note: ʻOku kei sivi ʻa e hū mai fakatuai ʻo e kaati: ʻoku totonu ʻa e ngaahi lau kaati mo e ngaahi ngataʻanga WIP, ka ʻoku fakahāhā pē ʻe he ngaahi vīsone Kalenita/Tēpile/Gantt mo e fili lahi ʻa e ngaahi kaati kuo ʻosi fakahū. Toe fakahū ʻa e ngaahi papa ʻoku ava hili hono liliu ʻo e meʻa ni.
render-links-as-plain-text: Fakahāhā ʻa e ngaahi fehokotakiʻanga ko ha tohi angamaheni
render-links-as-plain-text-description: ʻI he taimi kuo fakaava ai, ʻoku fakahāhā maʻu pē ʻa e ngaahi fehokotakiʻanga kotoa (ʻa e ngaahi fehokotakiʻanga markdown hangē ko e [label](url) mo e ngaahi tāki HTML <a href> moʻoni) ko ha tohi angamaheni ʻoku ʻikai lava ke lomiʻi ʻi he feituʻu tohi lahi kotoa pē (ngaahi kaveinga ʻo e papa mo e kaati, ngaahi fakamatala, ngaahi fakamatala ʻi lalo, ngaahi lisi sivi, mo e alā meʻa pehē). ʻOku taʻofi ʻe he meʻa ni ʻa e ngaahi fehokotakiʻanga fakahalaki. ʻOku tāmateʻi ʻi he tuʻumaʻu, ko ia ʻoku kei lava ke lomiʻi ʻa e ngaahi fehokotakiʻanga.
always-show-code-as-text: Fakahāhā maʻu pē ʻa e kouti kotoa ko ha tohi angamaheni
always-show-code-as-text-description: ʻI he taimi kuo fakaava ai, ʻoku ʻikai teitei fakahāhā ʻa e tohi lahi ko e markdown pe HTML: ʻoku fakahāhā maʻu pē ʻa e tupuʻanga kotoa ko ha tohi angamaheni ʻi he feituʻu tohi lahi kotoa pē (ngaahi kaveinga ʻo e papa mo e kaati, ngaahi fakamatala, ngaahi fakamatala ʻi lalo, ngaahi lisi sivi, mo e alā meʻa pehē). ʻOku fakahāhā ʻe he meʻa ni ʻa e ngaahi meʻa fufū — ngaahi fakamatala HTML (<!-- -->), ko e taumuʻa ʻo e ngaahi fehokotakiʻanga markdown, JavaScript mo ha kouti kehe pē — ko ia ʻoku hāmai maʻu pē ʻa e kouti kotoa, ʻikai lava ke lomiʻi, pea ʻikai lele. ʻOku tāmateʻi ʻi he tuʻumaʻu, ko ia ʻoku fakahāhā angamaheni ʻa e markdown.
disable-all-import: Tāmateʻi ʻa e ʻomi ki loto kotoa
disable-all-import-description: ʻI he taimi kuo fakaava ai, ʻoku tāmateʻi ʻa e ngaahi meʻa ʻomi ki loto kotoa: ʻomi ki loto ha papa mei he WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea mo Forgejo, pea mo hono fai ha tatau ʻo ha papa. ʻOku fakafufū ʻa e ngaahi fili ʻi he lisi ʻomi ki loto pea ʻoku fakafisingaʻi ʻe he sēvea ha kole ʻomi ki loto pē. ʻOku tāmateʻi ʻi he tuʻumaʻu.
disable-all-export-description: ʻI he taimi kuo fakaava ai, ʻoku tāmateʻi ʻa e ngaahi meʻa ʻave kotoa: ʻave ha papa ko e WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, pe ki he NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, pea mo e ʻave ʻo ha meʻa fakahoko ʻe taha. ʻOku fakafufū ʻa e ngaahi fili ʻi he lisi ʻave pea ʻoku fakafisingaʻi ʻe he sēvea ha kole ʻave pē. ʻOku tāmateʻi ʻi he tuʻumaʻu.
disable-import-avatars: Tāmateʻi ʻa e ʻomi ki loto ʻo e ʻata fakafofonga
disable-import-avatars-description: ʻI he taimi kuo fakaava ai, ʻoku ʻikai teitei ʻomi ki loto ʻa e ngaahi ʻata fakafofonga (ngaahi ʻata ʻo e fakamatala fakatāutaha ʻo e tokotaha ngāue). ʻOku kau heni ʻa e ʻomi ki loto WeKan JSON, ʻomi ki loto Trello, mo e fakatatau ʻata fakafofonga mei he ngaahi tokotaha tuʻa ʻoku ne ʻoatu ʻa e mafai ʻi he hū ki loto (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). ʻOku kei ʻomi ki loto ʻa e ngaahi hingoa mo e fakamatala kehe; ko e ngaahi ʻata fakafofonga pē ʻoku liʻaki. ʻOku tāmateʻi ʻi he tuʻumaʻu.
disable-export-avatars: Tāmateʻi ʻa e ʻave ʻo e ʻata fakafofonga
disable-export-avatars-description: ʻI he taimi kuo fakaava ai, ʻoku ʻikai teitei kau ʻa e ngaahi ʻata fakafofonga (ngaahi ʻata ʻo e fakamatala fakatāutaha ʻo e tokotaha ngāue) ʻi hono ʻave ha papa (ʻave WeKan JSON mo CSV). ʻOku kei ʻave ʻa e ngaahi hingoa ʻo e tokotaha ngāue mo e fakamatala kehe; ko e ngaahi ʻata fakafofonga pē ʻoku liʻaki. ʻOku tāmateʻi ʻi he tuʻumaʻu.
anonymize-import-users: Fakataʻehingoa ʻa e kau ngāue ʻoku ʻomi ki loto
anonymize-import-users-description: ʻI he taimi kuo fakaava ai, ʻoku fetongi ʻe hono ʻomi ki loto ha papa WeKan JSON ʻa e hingoa ngāue, hingoa kakato mo e ngaahi mataʻitohi ʻuluaki ʻo e tokotaha ngāue taki taha kuo ʻomi ki loto ʻaki ha ngaahi fetongiʻanga lau (user1, user2, ...), toʻo ʻenau ʻata fakafofonga, pea toe tohi ʻa e ngaahi lave @username (mo e ngaahi feituʻu requested-by / assigned-by) ʻi loto ʻi he ngaahi kaati mo e fakamatala ʻi lalo kuo ʻomi ki loto. ʻOku ʻikai tauhi ha fakamatala moʻoni ʻo ha tokotaha ngāue mei he papa tupuʻanga. ʻOku muimui ʻa e foʻi lea "user" ki he lea ʻa e tokotaha ʻoku ne ʻomi ki loto. ʻOku tāmateʻi ʻi he tuʻumaʻu.
anonymize-export-users: Fakataʻehingoa ʻa e kau ngāue ʻoku ʻave
anonymize-export-users-description: ʻI he taimi kuo fakaava ai, ʻoku fetongi ʻe hono ʻave ha papa ʻa e hingoa ngāue, hingoa kakato mo e ngaahi mataʻitohi ʻuluaki ʻo e tokotaha ngāue taki taha kuo ʻave ʻaki ha ngaahi fetongiʻanga lau (user1, user2, ...), toʻo ʻenau ʻata fakafofonga, pea toe tohi ʻa e ngaahi lave @username (mo e ngaahi feituʻu requested-by / assigned-by) ʻi loto ʻi he ngaahi kaati mo e fakamatala ʻi lalo. ʻOku ʻikai ha fakamatala moʻoni ʻo ha tokotaha ngāue ʻi he faile kuo ʻave. ʻOku muimui ʻa e foʻi lea "user" ki he lea ʻa e tokotaha ʻoku ne ʻave. ʻOku tāmateʻi ʻi he tuʻumaʻu.
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: ʻOku ke fakapapauʻi ke fakataʻehingoa ʻa e ʻakauni ni? ʻOku fetongi taʻengata ʻe he meʻa ni ʻa e hingoa ngāue, hingoa kakato mo e tuasila ʻīmeili ʻaki ha ngaahi mahuʻinga fetongiʻanga taʻehingoa, toʻo ʻa e ʻata fakafofonga, pea tāmateʻi ʻa e hū ki loto. ʻOku kehe ia mei he tāmateʻi, ʻoku kei tauhi ʻe he ngaahi papa, kaati mo e fakamatala ʻi lalo ʻenau hisitōlia pea kei fakahāhā ʻa e ʻakauni ni, ka ʻoku taʻehingoa pē. ʻOku ʻikai lava ke toe fakafoki ʻa e ngāue ni.
disable-activities: Tāmateʻi ʻa e ngaahi ngāue kotoa
disable-activities-description: ʻI he taimi kuo fakaava ai, ʻoku ʻikai teitei lēkooti pe fakahāhā ʻi ha feituʻu ʻa e ngaahi meʻa ʻo e lisi ngāue (tafaʻaki ʻo e papa mo e konga ngāue ʻo e kaati). ʻOku ʻikai tauhi ha hisitōlia ʻo hai naʻa ne fai ʻa e hā. ʻOku tāmateʻi ʻi he tuʻumaʻu.
disable-notifications: Tāmateʻi ʻa e ngaahi fakatokanga kotoa
disable-notifications-description: ʻI he taimi kuo fakaava ai, ʻoku ʻikai teitei ʻave ʻe he WeKan ha ngaahi fakatokanga leʻohi (ʻi he polokalama, ʻīmeili pe ngaahi sēvesi kehe) ki ha ngāue pē. ʻE kei lava ke lēkooti ʻa e ngaahi ngāue (tuku kehe kapau kuo tāmateʻi foki ʻi ʻolunga); ko e ngaahi fakatokanga pē ʻoku taʻofi. ʻOku tāmateʻi ʻi he tuʻumaʻu.
disable-watch-description: ʻI he taimi kuo fakaava ai, ʻoku tāmateʻi ʻa e meʻa leʻohi — ʻoku ʻikai lava ʻe he kau ngāue ke kau ki he ngaahi papa, lisi pe kaati ke maʻu ha ngaahi fakatokanga, pea ʻoku fakafisingaʻi ha feinga pē ke liliu ha tuʻunga leʻohi. ʻOku tāmateʻi ʻi he tuʻumaʻu.
backup-description: Tauhi ha tatau malu ʻo e ngaahi faile fakapipiki, ngaahi ʻata ʻo e kau ngāue mo/pe fakamatala (ngaahi fakatahatahaʻanga tohi kotoa pē ʻoku ʻikai ko ha faile fakapipiki pe ʻata ʻo e tokotaha ngāue). ʻOku ʻave fakahangatonu ʻa e .zip ki he tauʻanga kuo fili — ʻikai ha faile fakataimi — ko e backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, ʻoku ʻi loto ʻa e YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars mo e /data. ʻOku ngāueʻaki ʻe he ngaahi tauʻanga ʻi he ʻao (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) ʻa e fakamatala fakamoʻoni kuo fokotuʻutuʻu ʻi honau ngaahi tēpile tauʻanga.
backup-scope-description: Ko e ʻinisitenisi kakato, pe ha kautaha ʻe taha. ʻOku ʻi he tatau malu ʻo ha kautaha ʻa hono ngaahi papa mo e meʻa kotoa ʻi ai, kau ai ʻa e ngaahi meʻa fakahoko ʻo e ngaahi papa ko ia — ka ʻoku ʻikai ha ngaahi ʻakauni tokotaha ngāue pe ngaahi fokotuʻutuʻu ʻo e ʻinisitenisi, koeʻuhi ʻoku vahevahe ia ʻe he kautaha kotoa pē. ʻOku tohi pē ʻe hono fakafoki ʻo e tatau malu ʻo ha kautaha ki he ngaahi papa ʻoku ʻa e kautaha ko ia.
theme-override-all-tenants: Fetongi ʻoku ngāue ki he kau nofo kotoa
backup-now: Fai ha tatau malu he taimí ni
backup-done: Kuo ʻosi ʻa e tatau malu
backup-list: Lisi ʻo e ngaahi tatau malu
continuous-backup-description: ʻOku ʻave ʻa e liliu kotoa pē ʻo e tauʻanga fakamatala, ngaahi faile fakapipiki, ngaahi ʻata ʻo e kau ngāue mo e ngaahi lekooti ki ha foulutā ʻi ha ngaahi sekoni siʻi, ke lava ʻo fakafoki ki ha faʻahinga taimi pē. ʻOku ngāue fakataha mo e tauhi tatau kuo fakataimi, ʻa ia ʻoku ne faʻu ʻa e ngaahi tatau kakato.
continuous-backup-enabled: Fakalele ʻa e tauhi hokohoko ha tatau malu ʻi he sēva ko ʻeni
continuous-backup-target: Foulutā ke tauhi ki ai (hala kakato, ʻi ha toe tisiki, tauʻanga vahevahe ʻi he netiueka pe feituʻu ʻoku fakahoko ʻe rclone)
continuous-backup-include: Tauhi ha tatau malu ʻo e
continuous-backup-engine-oplog: Oplog (ʻi he taimi pē ko ia, liliu kotoa pē)
continuous-backup-engine-sqlite: Ngaahi peesi SQLite (ngaahi peesi kuo liliu ʻi he vahaʻa taimi takitaha)
continuous-backup-engine-litestream: Litestream (polokalama ke ke fokotuʻu kapau te ke fie ngāueʻaki)
continuous-backup-engine-none: ʻOku ʻikai ha mīsini ʻo e tauʻanga fakamatala ʻe lava ʻo ngāue ʻi he sēva ko ʻeni
continuous-backup-file-scan: Toe vakaiʻi ʻa e ngaahi faile kotoa pē (sekoni)
continuous-backup-base-every: Faʻu ha tatau tefito foʻou ʻi he vahaʻa taimi (houa)
continuous-backup-encrypt: Fufuuʻi ʻa e tatau malu ʻaki ha kouti fakapulipuli (AES-256-GCM)
continuous-backup-key-file: Faile ʻo e kī ki he kouti fakapulipuli (hala kakato ʻi tuʻa mei he foulutā ke tauhi ki ai; mataʻitohi ʻe 64 ʻo e founga fika fakavaʻe 16 pe ha kupuʻi lea fakapulipuli ʻoku ʻikai siʻi hifo ʻi he mataʻitohi ʻe 16). Tauhi ha tatau: ka ʻikai ʻa e faile ni, he ʻikai lava ke fakafoki ʻa e tatau malu.
continuous-backup-upload-none: ʻIkai ha feituʻu (ko e foulutā ke tauhi ki ai pē)
continuous-backup-upload-prefix: Foulutā ʻi loto ʻi he kane tauhiʻanga
continuous-backup-fetched: Kuo ʻomi ʻa e ngaahi faile mei he ʻao
continuous-backup-litestream-binary: Faile fakalele ʻo e Litestream (hala kakato)
continuous-backup-restore-points: Ngaahi taimi ke fakafoki ki ai
continuous-backup-restore-to: Fakafoki ki he (ʻaho mo e taimi)
continuous-backup-restore-sqlite: Faile ʻo e tauʻanga fakamatala SQLite (ʻoku faʻu ʻi he tafaʻaki ʻo e tatau malu, ʻoku ʻikai ʻaupito tohi ki he funga ʻo e faile ʻoku lolotonga ngāueʻaki)
continuous-backup-apply-on-restart: Ngāueʻaki ʻa e tauʻanga fakamatala SQLite kuo toe faʻu ʻi he toe kamata hoko (ʻe tauhi ʻa e tauʻanga fakamatala motuʻa ʻoku fetongi)
continuous-backup-restore-confirm: Fakafoki ʻa e toʻutangata kuo fili ki he taimi kuo fili? ʻE tuʻu fakataimi ʻa e tauhi hokohoko ha tatau malu lolotonga ʻa e fakafoki.
continuous-backup-saved: Kuo tauhi ʻa e ngaahi fokotuʻutuʻu ʻo e tauhi hokohoko ha tatau malu
backup-restore-add-missing: Tānaki pē ʻa e fakamatala ʻoku mole
backup-restore-select-first: Fili ʻuluaki ha tatau malu mei he lisi.
backup-restore-confirm: Fakafoki ʻa e tatau malu kuo fili? ʻOku tohi ʻa e ngaahi faile fakapipiki/ʻata ʻo e kau ngāue ki he sisitemi faile pea mo e fakamatala ki he tauʻanga fakamatala ʻo fakatatau ki he founga kuo fili.
gcs-key-filename: Hala ʻo e faile kī ʻo e ʻakauni sēvesi
gcs-key-filename-description: Fili pē: hala ki ha faile kī JSON ʻo e ʻakauni sēvesi ʻi he sēvea.
gcs-credentials: Ngaahi fakamoʻoni ʻo e ʻakauni sēvesi (JSON)
gcs-credentials-description: Fili pē: pēsiti ʻa e kī JSON ʻo e ʻakauni sēvesi. Tuku ke ʻatā ke ngāueʻaki ʻa e faile kī pe ngaahi fakamoʻoni tuʻumaʻu.
gcs-permissions-note: ʻOatu ki he ʻakauni sēvesi ʻa WeKan ʻa e ngofua lau/tohi ki he pakete: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → hoʻo pakete → Permissions → Grant access. ʻI he "New principals", pēsiti ʻa e ʻīmeili ʻo e ʻakauni sēvesi — ko e mahuʻinga "client_email" mei hoʻo kī JSON — pea fili ʻa e fatongia "Storage Object Admin" pea Save.
cloud-secret-keep-blank: Tuku ke ʻatā ke tauhi ʻa e mahuʻinga lolotonga.
azure-account-name-description: Ko e hingoa ʻo hoʻo ʻakauni Azure Storage.
azure-container-description: Ko e puha tauhi blob ke tauhi ai ʻa e ngaahi faile.

gcs-bucket-description: Ko e hingoa ʻo e pakete Cloud Storage ke tauhi ai ʻa e ngaahi faile.

azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → hoʻo ʻakauni → Data storage → Containers → hoʻo puha tauhi (pe + Container ke faʻu ha taha).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → fili poloseki ʻi ʻolunga → ID ʻo hoʻo poloseki (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).

gcs-key-filename-menu-path: Hala ʻi he sēvea WeKan ki he faile kī JSON ʻo e ʻakauni sēvesi kuo hiki hifo (faʻu ʻi lalo). Ngāueʻaki eni PE pēsiti ʻa e JSON ki he feituʻu ʻi lalo.

email-recovery-heading: Hokohoko talitali ki hono ʻave ʻo e ʻīmeilí
email-recovery-description: Laine ʻe taha ki he tokotaha takitaha ʻoku ne maʻu. Kumi ʻaki e ID ʻo e tokotaha ngāue. ʻOku ʻikai fakaʻaliʻali ʻa e kakano ʻo e pōpoakí mo e ngaahi konga ʻīmeili ʻo e tokotaha ʻoku ne maʻu. Ko e taʻofi fakataimí ʻoku ne taʻofi ʻa e ngaahi pōpoaki lolotongá mo e ngaahi pōpoaki ʻe toki hoko mai; ko e hoko atú ʻoku ne toe feinga he taimí ni ke ʻave ʻa e ngaahi pōpoaki ʻoku talitalí. Ko e fakataʻeʻaongá ʻoku ne toʻo ʻa e ngaahi pōpoaki naʻe ʻosi tuku ki he hokohokó ʻo aʻu ki he taimi ʻo e kolé. Kapau ʻoku lolotonga ʻave, toe feinga hili ha kiʻi taimi. ʻOku ʻikai lava ke fakafoki mai ha pōpoaki kuo kamata hono ʻavé, pea ʻe lava ke toe ʻave ʻa e pōpoaki ʻoku ʻikai fakapapauʻi hono tuʻunga ʻo e ʻavé. ʻOku kei tuku ʻa e ngaahi ʻikai malava tuʻuloá mo e ngaahi pōpoaki kuo aʻu ki he fakangatangata ʻo e feingá ke vakaiʻi. Ko e toe feinga ki he ngaahi pōpoaki naʻe ʻikai malavá ʻoku ne kamata ha siakale feinga foʻou pea tauhi ʻa e taʻofi fakataimi ʻoku lolotonga ʻi aí.

optional-apis-desc: Ngaahi REST API ʻoku hangē ko e ngaahi API ʻa e ngaahi polokalama muimui kehe, koeʻuhi ke lava ʻe heʻenau ngaahi ʻapi mo e sikilipi ʻo ngāueʻaki ʻa e WeKan ko ʻeni ko honau tuʻunga ki mui: ko e meʻa ʻoku nau tauhí ʻoku tukuhau ia ʻi he WeKan, ʻi he ngaahi papa ʻo e WeKan. ʻOku tāmateʻi ʻa e taki taha kae ʻoua kuo fakaʻilongaʻi heni. ʻOku ʻikai ha taha ʻoku ʻi ai hono totonu pē ʻoʻona: ʻoku hū mai ha kasitomā ʻaki ha API token ʻo e WeKan, pea ʻoku lava pē ke ne sio mo liliu ʻa e meʻa ʻoku lava ʻe he tokotaha ko iá ʻo sio mo liliu ʻi he WeKan. ʻOku fiemaʻu kotoa ke ʻulu ʻa e REST API ʻo e WeKan (WITH_API=true). Ko e tuʻasila ʻi lalo ʻi he taki taha ko e meʻa ia ʻoku ngāueʻaki ʻe ha kasitomā ko ʻene sevá.
optional-api-trello-desc: Ko e ngaahi ʻapi mo e sikilipi naʻe faʻu ki he REST API ʻa Trello (hangē ko Trellinator) ʻoku ngāue mo e WeKan: ngaahi papa, ngaahi lisi, ngaahi kaati, ngaahi fakaʻilonga, kau mēmipa, ngaahi fakamatala mo e ngaahi lisi sivi. Ko e token ʻa Trello ko ha API token ia ʻo e WeKan. Ko hono tāmateʻi ha kaati ʻoku hiki ia ki he tukuʻanga ʻi he WeKan.
optional-api-jira-desc: Ko e kau kasitomā ʻo e REST API v2 ʻa Jira ʻoku ngāue mo e WeKan: ko ha poloseki ko ha papa ia (ko hono kī ko e kī ʻo e papa), ko ha palopalema ko ha kaati ia (DEV-7), ko ha tuʻunga ko ha lisi ia, pea ʻoku hiki ʻe ha liliu ʻa e kaati. ʻOku tali ʻe he kumi ʻa e JQL faingofua: project, status, assignee = currentUser(), text mo ORDER BY. Hū mai ʻaki ha API token ʻo e WeKan ko e lea fakapulipuli. Ko hono tāmateʻi ha palopalema ʻoku hiki ia ki he tukuʻanga.
optional-api-github-desc: Ko e kau kasitomā ʻo e REST API ʻa GitHub ki he ngaahi palopalema ʻoku ngāue mo e WeKan: ko ha tukuʻanga koute ko ha papa ia, ko ha palopalema ko ha kaati ia, mo e ngaahi fakaʻilonga, ngaahi tuʻunga mahuʻinga (ngaahi fakaʻilonga mo ha ʻaho ngataʻanga), ngaahi fakamatala, pea ava pe tāpuni hangē ko ia ʻi he Founga sio ʻo e papa / Puleʻi ʻo e ngaahi pulusi. Ko e token ko ha API token ia ʻo e WeKan.
optional-api-gitea-desc: Ko e kau kasitomā ʻo e REST API ʻa Gitea mo Forgejo ki he ngaahi palopalema ʻoku ngāue mo e WeKan, ʻi he founga tatau pē mo e API ʻoku feʻunga mo GitHub: ko ha tukuʻanga koute ko ha papa ia pea ko ha palopalema ko ha kaati ia. Ko e token ko ha API token ia ʻo e WeKan.

webhook-internal-hosts-desc: ʻOku ʻikai lava ʻa e ngaahi webhook ʻoku ʻave ki tuʻa ʻo aʻu ki he ngaahi tuasila ʻi he netiueka pē ʻa WeKan, koeʻuhi ke ʻoua naʻa lava ha taha ʻo fakahangatonu ʻa e webhook ʻo ha papa ki ha sēvesi ʻi loto. Tohi heni ʻa e ngaahi sēvā ʻi he netiueka ko iá ʻoku ngofua ke aʻu ki ai ʻa e ngaahi webhook - ha Node-RED, ha sēvā talanoa - taha ki he laine taki taha, ko ha hingoa pe ko ha tuasila, mo ha matapā ke fakaʻatā pē ʻa e matapā ko iá. Maha: ʻikai ha taha. Ko e kau pule pē ʻo e uepisaití ʻoku lava ʻo liliu ʻa e lisi ko ʻení.
